from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
def build(k):
    G=np.tanh(k*t)
    cols={'G':G,'P':P,'P2':P**2,'P3':P**3,'Pt':P*t,'PG':P*G,'P2G':P**2*G,'P3G':P**3*G,'tG':t*G,'t':t,'P2t':P**2*t,'Pt2':P*t*t,'1':np.ones_like(P)}

def fit(k,keys):

    X=np.c_[tuple(cols[q] for q in keys)]
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-X@c
